notes: Iteration 1 ships infrastructure only. The 3 pilot evals exercise UC-1 (pre-trivial-coverage-gap) and UC-2 (post-small-diff-clean, post-large-diff-mixed) per spec §12.3 lines 971-981. The 15 promotion evals exercise the §14.5.2 9-condition strict gate across all branches per spec §14.5.7 lines 1343-1363. The 2 falsifier entries reference SKELETON cases (status: skeleton-pending-iteration-3-fixture per W-A8 spec-panel fix); the runtime `convergence_score < 0.75 OR verdict == regression_present` assertion is layered in iteration-3 follow-up when the placeholder fixture content is authored. Pilot eval case fixtures (cases/<name>/input/*, expected.yaml) are STUBS in v1.0 — see Steps 5.6-5.8 in TASK-RF-20260527-043715-sc-reflect-rebuild. Promotion fixture YAMLs are STUBS in v1.0 — see Steps 5.10-5.24. All assertion types referenced here are defined in grader.py (10 new types per refs/grader-extensions.md + 8 baseline types inherited from sc-brainstorm). Reflect-V3-Serena adds 6 SCAFFOLDED serena cases (ids 21-26) covering FR-RV3-LOW.1–8: serena-find-implementations (FR-1), serena-find-declaration (FR-2, also hosts FR-3 references_extended_info), serena-search-deps (FR-4), serena-wave0-config (FR-6+FR-7), serena-memory-retention (FR-8), serena-summarize-changes (FR-5, pilot/ships-last per OQ-3). These are SCAFFOLDS — input fixtures + expected.yaml (STUB) + assertions[] targeting future with_skill/outputs/; not executed/graded in this task. See TASK-RF-20260602-135209.
